episodes.synopsis: Former servant Xin now commands 300 troops in the formidable Fei Xin Force--and the big battle he's itching for may be right around the corner.
episodes.title: New Era

episodes.synopsis: Zhao's master tactician Li Mu is forced into negotiations with Qin's crafty Lü Buwei. What will the outcome mean for the future of their kingdoms?
episodes.title: A Quiet Battlefield

episodes.synopsis: Xin confronts Li Mu, the man who orchestrated Wang Yi's battlefield defeat, while Diao touches base with Kaine. Zheng reveals his future plans.
episodes.title: A Tumultuous Banquet

episodes.synopsis: Xin gets a lead on a big battle that could propel him up the ranks to general, but soon learns he's not the only young, ambitious warrior around.
episodes.title: Kings and Ants

episodes.synopsis: As the Fei Xin and Yu Feng Forces play at one-upmanship, Si Shi proposes a surprising potential ally in Zheng's power struggle with Lü Buwei.
episodes.title: A Third Force

episodes.synopsis: Zheng's supporters discuss the pros and cons of bringing the Queen Dowager onto their side, while Zheng takes matters into his own hands.
episodes.title: Beautiful Venom

episodes.synopsis: Zheng tells Xiang about his days as a young hostage in Zhao, and about the unexpected people called upon to get him safely back to the Kingdom of Qin.
episodes.title: A Cursed Prince

episodes.synopsis: The flashback to young Zheng's escape from hostile Zhao to his Qin homeland reveals the startling effects of the mental and physical abuse he'd endured.
episodes.title: Zheng and Zi Xia

episodes.synopsis: Zheng's flashback shows the lengths to which a black marketeer was willing to go to make sure he got home and became King of Qin, against all odds.
episodes.title: Binding Wish

episodes.synopsis: As Zheng and his supporters await word from the Inner Palace, the Queen Dowager reveals where her allegiances lie. Xiang is put in a tight spot.
episodes.title: Broken Love

episodes.synopsis: Xiang struggles to bring Zheng some shocking news. The Qin army mounts its offensive against Wei's Gaolang Castle, but is Xin in over his head?
episodes.title: Assemblage

episodes.synopsis: Wang Ben's Yu Feng Force tries unconventional tactics to gain ground in the siege of Gaolang Castle. Lü Buwei's actions start to have consequences.
episodes.title: Siege of Gaolang Castle

episodes.synopsis: As Qin's war against Wei rages on, Xin follows his convictions only to land in hot water. A new opponent emerges that could turn the tide of battle.
episodes.title: My Way of Fighting

episodes.synopsis: Lian Po, once one of Zhao's Three Greats, is called to the battlefield again. The Fei Xin Force tries unconventional tactics to storm Jinliguan.
episodes.title: The Man Lian Po

episodes.synopsis: An assassin is picking off Qin's thousand-man commanders! Xin encounters a formidable young man who sees promise in the scrappy Fei Xin leader.
episodes.title: Air of a Military Commander

episodes.synopsis: Lian Po gives his reasons for returning to the battlefield. A chance meeting in the dead of night could have a major impact on Xin's military career.
episodes.title: Midnight Great General

episodes.synopsis: Xin settles into his new position as the Qin army prepares for a battle that could change the face of China. Qiang Lei discusses her plans with Xin.
episodes.title: The Night Before the Start of War

episodes.synopsis: The battle at Shanyang is underway. Xin and his fellow temporary thousand-man commanders must face the fearsome Lian Po--and the deadly Lun Hu.
episodes.title: Clash!

episodes.synopsis: As Wang Ben and the Yu Feng Force do battle with Lun Hu, the Fei Xin Force is called into battle. A devious strategy takes the Qin army by surprise.
episodes.title: Xuan Feng's Scheme

episodes.synopsis: The Qin army is at a standstill in their battle against Wei--until Qiang Lei devises a workaround. Will her idea be enough for them to claim victory?
episodes.title: The Feixin Unit's Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: Meng Ao's lieutenant Huan Yi takes the battlefield with some real tricks up his sleeve. The Wei army must scramble to beat him at his own game.
episodes.title: The Thief vs. The Strategist

episodes.synopsis: After Huan Yi's masterstroke, Meng Tian suggests the Le Hua, Yu Feng, and Fei Xin Forces team up in the hopes of leaving their own mark on history.
episodes.title: Meng Tian's Proposal

episodes.synopsis: Meng Tian skillfully brings all three special forces together in his plan to eliminate Lun Hu, but will the shrewd assassin fall prey to his scheme?
episodes.title: United Front of Three Units

episodes.synopsis: Bi gets a surprise visit and a new role in the battle against Wei, while Wang Ben and Xin fight against time to put an end to the masterful Lun Hu.
episodes.title: A Wall That Must be Overcome

episodes.synopsis: Lieutenant Wang Jian's plot comes to fruition with help from the skillful Commander Bi, but the battle--and the battle of wits--is far from over.
episodes.title: Double Bluff

episodes.synopsis: Lian Po judges Wang Jian's worth as a commander, while a badly injured Xin returns to camp. The end of the Shanyang Offensive is in sight at last.
episodes.title: The Caliber of a General

episodes.synopsis: The Le Hua, Yu Feng, and Fei Xin Forces find themselves bringing up the rear in the final battle. Lian Po makes a daring move to get the ball rolling.
episodes.title: The Hour of Conclusion

episodes.synopsis: Meng Ao reveals a surprising strategy for taking on Lian Po in hopes of finally claiming victory over his rival. Xin's battle with Lun Hu intensifies.
episodes.title: The Final Plan

episodes.synopsis: Xin must cope with a grave injury in his fight to take Lun Hu's head. Lian Po continues his seemingly unstoppable march on Meng Ao's main camp.
episodes.title: A Single Moment

episodes.synopsis: As his battle with Lun Hu ends, Xin remembers the people he met along his path. Jie Zifang's men launch a brutal attack against the wounded Qiang Lei.
episodes.title: Precious Comrades

episodes.synopsis: It's a showdown between Meng Ao and Lian Po as the mighty generals face each other for the first time in forty years. Will Meng Ao have his revenge?
episodes.title: Meng Ao, Standing Firm

episodes.synopsis: Meng Ao encourages Lian Po to leave the past behind and embrace a new era. Bai Guixi gets an unexpected visitor that could turn the tables on Wei.
episodes.title: Unfading Era

episodes.synopsis: With the Shanyang Offensive over, Lian Po shares with Xin a sure way of achieving great fame and glory. Qiang Lei prepares to leave the Fei Xin Force.
episodes.title: Victory... And...

episodes.synopsis: Despite the recognition Xin receives after the Shanyang Offensive, the Fei Xin Force just hasn't been the same. Perhaps a new tactician is in order...
episodes.title: The Strategist Arrives

episodes.synopsis: The Fei Xin Force is eyeing tactician He Liao Diao with great distrust, but who else can think up a way to deal with the latest wave of Wei attackers?
episodes.title: Trial and Resolve

episodes.synopsis: He Liao Diao pulls out all the stops in a strategy meant to shut down Wei troops bent on revenge for the Fei Xin Force's fierce battle at Shanyang.
episodes.title: Outwit

episodes.synopsis: Zhao makes a surprising move, while the Fei Xin Force makes a discovery. Back in Xianyang, Zheng reveals a trump card in the Court's power struggle.
episodes.title: Distant Thunder

episodes.synopsis: Zheng approaches his stepbrother for help ousting Lü Buwei. The Fei Xin Force fights to defend a tiny country and stumbles onto something huge.
episodes.title: Stage of Strategy

episodes.synopsis: New ministers take positions in the Royal Court, and Xiang has big news for Zheng. Xin sees a potential problem as a way to get closer to his goal.
episodes.title: A New Legend
